common.save_failed.zh-TW: 暫時無法儲存，請再試一次。
common.save_failed.en: We couldn't save just now. Please try again.

sports.scene.zh-TW: 立體運動場館，可使用下方按鈕切換視角
sports.scene.en: Dimensional sports venue. Use the buttons below to change the view.

sports.detail_0.zh-TW: 選一座場館，換個角度看看海景與器材，想動一動時再開始。
sports.detail_0.en: Choose a venue, explore the sea views and equipment from another angle, and move when you feel like it.

sports.detail_1.zh-TW: 沿著池緣看看海，或輕輕入水，留一點時間給自己。
sports.detail_1.en: Watch the sea from the poolside, or slip into the water and take a moment for yourself.

sports.detail_2.zh-TW: 面海的木質健身房。試試跑步機的輕鬆動作，隨時可以休息。
sports.detail_2.en: A wooden gym facing the sea. Try a gentle treadmill movement and rest whenever you like.

sports.detail_3.zh-TW: 看看球網、場線與海風，試一段短暫的擊球動作。完整對打尚未開放。
sports.detail_3.en: Explore the net and court markings, then try a brief hitting movement. Full matches are not available yet.

sports.detail_4.en: Slip gently into the water and float for a moment.

sports.detail_5.zh-TW: 跟著自己的步調，輕鬆動一動…
sports.detail_5.en: Move gently, at your own pace…

nomad.status.zh-TW: 施工中 · 尚未公布開幕日期
nomad.status.en: Under construction · Opening date not announced

nomad.preview.zh-TW: Nomad House 建築概念預覽

nomad.concept.zh-TW: 建築概念預覽；四個生活區域尚未開放。
nomad.concept.en: Architectural concept preview; the four living areas are not open yet.

nomad.intro.zh-TW: 即使需要工作，也可以在一個溫暖、自在的小世界裡完成。烏布雨林的自然感，與長谷共享工作的自在節奏。
nomad.intro.en: Even when work calls, you can do it in a warm little world. Inspired by the greenery of Ubud and the easy coworking rhythm of Canggu.

nomad.safe.zh-TW: 請留在木圍籬外的步道。工程熊熊正在整理竹材與木平台。
nomad.safe.en: Please stay on the path outside the wooden fence. Our builder is preparing bamboo and a timber deck.

nomad.workCopy.zh-TW: 竹木長桌、藤椅與筆電。以後可以在這裡工作或閱讀。
nomad.workCopy.en: Bamboo tables, rattan chairs and laptops. A future spot to work or read.

nomad.coffeeCopy.zh-TW: 一杯虛擬咖啡，陪你放慢腳步。
nomad.coffeeCopy.en: A virtual coffee to help you slow down.

nomad.deckCopy.zh-TW: 海風、躺椅與綠植，留一個不用努力的角落。
nomad.deckCopy.en: Sea breezes, loungers and greenery. A corner where you can simply be.

nomad.focusCopy.zh-TW: 安靜工作或閱讀；可選的陪伴計時將於後續階段加入。
nomad.focusCopy.en: Work or read quietly. An optional companion timer will follow in a later phase.

nomad.promise.zh-TW: 這裡不需要打卡、排名或完成任務。你也可以只是來待一會。
nomad.promise.en: No check-ins, rankings or tasks. You can simply stay a while.

nomad.hint.zh-TW: 熱帶共享工作屋正在準備中。先看看建築概念，開幕日期尚未公布
nomad.hint.en: A tropical coworking retreat is taking shape. Preview the concept; no opening date has been announced

nomad.structureStatus.zh-TW: 屋架施工中 · 尚未開放入內
nomad.structureStatus.en: Structure taking shape · Not open for entry

nomad.progressImage.zh-TW: Nomad House 屋架施工進度

nomad.progressCaption.zh-TW: 竹屋架與部分茅草屋頂已成形，木平台、藤椅與熱帶綠植正在準備中。
nomad.progressCaption.en: The bamboo frame and partial thatch roof are taking shape. A timber deck, rattan seating and tropical plants are being prepared.

nomad.progressSafety.zh-TW: 步道已連接至施工告示；圍籬內仍在施工，尚未公布開幕日期。
nomad.progressSafety.en: The path leads to the construction sign. Work continues inside the fence; no opening date has been announced.

nomadLive.welcome.zh-TW: 工作、閱讀，或只是和大家待在一起。今天不需要完成任何事。
nomadLive.welcome.en: Work, read, or simply share a little space. There is nothing you have to finish today.

nomadLive.panHelp.zh-TW: 手機可左右滑動場景，或使用區域按鈕找到座位。
nomadLive.panHelp.en: On mobile, swipe across the scene or use the area buttons to find a seat.

nomadLive.choose.en: Choose an empty seat and settle in.

nomadLive.workNote.zh-TW: 竹屋頂下的長桌留著筆電與書本。點空位坐下，再選想做的事。
nomadLive.workNote.en: Laptops and books await beneath the bamboo roof. Choose an empty seat, then do what feels right.

nomadLive.coffeeNote.zh-TW: 沿用海邊咖啡館的虛擬飲品。先取一杯，想喝時再喝一口。
nomadLive.coffeeNote.en: Enjoy the same virtual drinks as the seaside cafe. Pick a cup and take a sip whenever you like.

nomadLive.deckNote.zh-TW: 木露台、藤椅與小水景，陪你伸個懶腰，或什麼都不想。
nomadLive.deckNote.en: A timber deck, rattan chairs and gentle water. Stretch a little or let your mind wander.

nomadLive.focusNote.zh-TW: 獨立座位適合安靜工作或閱讀。可以開啟「減少動畫與聲音」。
nomadLive.focusNote.en: An individual seat for quiet work or reading. Turn on Reduce motion and sound for less distraction.

nomadLive.walking.en: Taking a gentle walk along the aisle…

nomadLive.quietSound.zh-TW: 安靜模式已開啟；環境音保持關閉。
nomadLive.quietSound.en: Quiet mode is on; ambient sound stays off.

nomadLive.audioUnavailable.zh-TW: 目前無法播放環境音，你仍可以安靜地待著。
nomadLive.audioUnavailable.en: Ambient sound is unavailable. You can still enjoy the quiet.

nomad.openHint.zh-TW: 熱帶工作屋開門了。找個座位工作、閱讀、喝咖啡，或在露台放空
nomad.openHint.en: The tropical retreat is open. Find a seat to work, read or have a coffee, or unwind on the deck

adventure.v87.5.en: Listen to the sea from the boardwalk

adventure.v87.7.zh-TW: 跟著 Ari 探索五站，也可以隨時自由散步。
adventure.v87.7.en: Explore five stops with Ari, with freedom to wander anytime.

adventure.v87.10.zh-TW: 散步、聽海，再觀察一位野生朋友。
adventure.v87.10.en: Take a walk, listen to the sea and observe a wild friend.

adventure.v87.13.zh-TW: 每日下午與晚間都能相遇，白天也有補遇步道。
adventure.v87.13.en: Meet every afternoon and evening, or take the catch-up trail any time.

adventure.v87.16.zh-TW: 台灣時間每天更新，錯過不扣分。
adventure.v87.16.en: Renews daily in Taiwan time. No penalty for missing a day.

adventure.v87.19.zh-TW: 接受一位既有居民來訪，完成一次小屋聊天。
adventure.v87.19.en: Welcome an island resident and share a cottage conversation.

adventure.v87.28.en: Please use the actions shown on this page.

adventure.v87.29.zh-TW: 冒險功能暫時無法使用，原本的資料仍保留。
adventure.v87.29.en: Adventure is temporarily unavailable. Your existing data is safe.

adventure.v87.30.zh-TW: 日期已更新，請重新打開手帳。
adventure.v87.30.en: The date has changed. Please reopen your journal.

adventure.v87.31.zh-TW: NPC 拜訪已關閉。你可以在冒險手帳重新開啟。
adventure.v87.31.en: NPC visits are off. Turn them on in your adventure journal.

adventure.v87.33.zh-TW: 互動已更新，請回到場景再試。
adventure.v87.33.en: This interaction has changed. Return to the scene and try again.

adventure.v87.34.zh-TW: 今天的拜訪選擇已保存。
adventure.v87.34.en: Today's visit choice has been saved.

adventure.v87.36.zh-TW: 這是公共探索步道，不會開放任何私人島嶼。
adventure.v87.36.en: This public trail does not grant access to private islands.

adventure.v87.37.zh-TW: 這次互動已保存，可以到手帳查看進度。
adventure.v87.37.en: Your interaction was saved. See your progress in the journal.

adventure.v87.39.zh-TW: 山羌每天 14:00–21:00 在觀景坡出現；其他時間可走補遇步道。以伺服器台灣時間為準，不必熬夜。
adventure.v87.39.en: Muntjacs visit the lookout daily from 14:00 to 21:00 Taiwan server time. The catch-up trail is open at all other times. No late nights needed.

adventure.v87.41.en: Look for a muntjac at the lookout

adventure.v87.42.en: Meet a muntjac on the catch-up trail

adventure.v87.43.zh-TW: 貝殼先留在海灘。背包與撿取會在下一階段加入。
adventure.v87.43.en: Leave the shells on the beach for now. Collecting and backpacks will arrive in the next phase.

adventure.v87.44.zh-TW: Ari 陪你認識島上五個角落，約五分鐘。隨時可跳過，不影響自由探索。
adventure.v87.44.en: Ari introduces five island corners in about five minutes. Skip anytime and keep exploring freely.

adventure.v87.45.zh-TW: 進度與收藏已保存，重複操作不會重複發獎。
adventure.v87.45.en: Progress and keepsakes are saved. Repeating actions will not duplicate rewards.

adventure.v87.50.en: Skip the tour and explore freely

adventure.v87.51.zh-TW: 可以回到任何一站；已完成的進度會保留。
adventure.v87.51.en: Return to any stop. Your completed progress is kept.

adventure.v87.54.zh-TW: 自由探索，慢慢完成就好。
adventure.v87.54.en: Explore freely and finish at your own pace.

adventure.v87.56.zh-TW: 每天最多一位新朋友，不會自動跳出打擾。稍後會安靜一小時；拒絕不影響友情或獎勵。
adventure.v87.56.en: At most one new visitor a day, with no pop-ups. Later keeps things quiet for an hour. Declining has no friendship or reward penalty.

adventure.v87.59.zh-TW: 朋友想來聽你分享小屋最喜歡的角落；聊完可完成來訪任務。
adventure.v87.59.en: Your friend would love to hear about your favorite cottage corner. Chat to complete the visit quest.

adventure.v87.63.zh-TW: 喜歡窗邊的光，還是桌邊的安靜？朋友陪你留下今天的小回憶。
adventure.v87.63.en: Do you prefer the window light or the quiet by your desk? Share a little memory with your friend.

adventure.v87.64.zh-TW: 分享最喜歡的小屋角落

adventure.v87.65.zh-TW: 招呼限 120 字，請使用友善文字，不加入連結、聯絡方式或控制字元。
adventure.v87.65.en: Use a friendly greeting of up to 120 characters, without links, contact details or control characters.

adventure.v87.66.zh-TW: 請稍等 30 秒再更新招呼。
adventure.v87.66.en: Please wait 30 seconds before updating your greeting.

adventure.v87.68.zh-TW: 最多 120 字，每 30 秒可更新一次。
adventure.v87.68.en: Up to 120 characters. Update once every 30 seconds.

adventure.week.note.zh-TW: 本週到森林觀察山羌，再去海邊聽海。下週仍有新的機會。
adventure.week.note.en: Observe a muntjac and listen to the sea this week. There is another opportunity next week.

adventure.publicTrail.zh-TW: 沿著步道慢慢走，今天也有新的風景。
adventure.publicTrail.en: Follow the trail at your own pace. There is something new to notice today.

adventure.beachPause.zh-TW: 把貝殼留給海浪，今天先聽聽海。
adventure.beachPause.en: Leave the shells to the waves and enjoy the sound of the sea.

adventure.incomplete.zh-TW: 任務尚未完成，請繼續探索。
adventure.incomplete.en: This quest is not complete yet. Keep exploring at your own pace.

mapGuide.1.zh-TW: 想再認識島上的角落嗎？Ari 會在地圖上陪你走一遍。
mapGuide.1.en: Would you like another look around? Ari will guide you on the map.

mapGuide.2.en: Replay the tour on the map

mapGuide.5.en: Finish the tour and explore freely

mapGuide.7.zh-TW: 歡迎來到島上！我是 Ari。港口是出發與接朋友的地方，先在地圖上認識你的新生活。
mapGuide.7.en: Welcome to the island! I'm Ari. The harbor is where journeys begin and friends arrive. Let's explore your new life on the map.

mapGuide.8.zh-TW: 榕樹廣場可以認識居民、打招呼和找活動。點地圖上的居民，就能聊聊。
mapGuide.8.en: Meet residents, say hello and find activities in Banyan Square. Tap a resident on the map to chat.

mapGuide.9.zh-TW: 這裡是你的小屋入口。家具、服裝與收藏都會跟著你的島民證保存。
mapGuide.9.en: Here is the entrance to your cottage. Your furniture, clothes and keepsakes stay with your resident passport.

mapGuide.10.zh-TW: 從自然休憩區走進雪松森林，可以觀察動物；錯過時段也有補遇步道。
mapGuide.10.en: Follow the nature area into Cedar Woods to observe animals. The catch-up trail helps you meet them at other times.

mapGuide.11.zh-TW: 貝殼海灘適合聽海放空。現在已認識五個角落，接著想去哪裡，由你決定。
mapGuide.11.en: Shell Beach is a place to enjoy the waves. Now that you know five island corners, choose where to go next.

welcome.title.zh-TW: 歡迎登島，先和 Ari 走一圈
welcome.title.en: Welcome aboard. Let Ari show you around

welcome.subtitle.zh-TW: 約五分鐘，認識你的島嶼生活
welcome.subtitle.en: About five minutes to discover island life

welcome.hello.zh-TW: 這張島民證就是你的新生活起點。我是 Ari，陪你看看哪裡能交朋友、玩一下，或安靜待著。
welcome.hello.en: Your passport is the start of island life. I’m Ari. Let’s find places to meet friends, play, or simply unwind.

welcome.mapNote.zh-TW: 這是玩法示意圖；各區實際位置以島嶼地圖為準。
welcome.mapNote.en: This is a guide to activities; use the island map for actual locations.

welcome.chapter0.zh-TW: 先看看：這座島可以怎麼玩？
welcome.chapter0.en: First, what can you do here?

welcome.chapter1.zh-TW: 認識朋友，也找到想參加的活動
welcome.chapter1.en: Meet friends and find an activity

welcome.chapter2.zh-TW: 把小屋變成喜歡的樣子
welcome.chapter2.en: Make your cottage feel like home

welcome.chapter3.zh-TW: 沿著森林，遇見野生朋友
welcome.chapter3.en: Follow the woodland trail and meet wildlife

welcome.chapter4.zh-TW: 聽一會海，選你的第一段旅程
welcome.chapter4.en: Enjoy the waves and choose your first outing

welcome.note0.zh-TW: 從港口出發，到廣場認識居民、回家布置小屋，或走進森林與海灘。想動一動就去運動俱樂部；想喝咖啡、閱讀或工作，可以去 Nomad House。
welcome.note0.en: Start at the harbor, meet residents in the square, decorate at home, or explore the woods and beach. Visit the Sports Club to move, or Nomad House for coffee, reading and work.

welcome.note1.zh-TW: 廣場有島民招呼、居民與活動。可以自己寫一句問候，也能查看揪團的時間與內容，再決定是否參加。
welcome.note1.en: The square brings together greetings, residents and activities. Write a greeting or read a meetup’s time and details before joining.

welcome.note2.zh-TW: 家具、服裝與收藏都跟著你的島民證保存。回家後可以布置、坐下或休息；想讓居民來坐坐，到冒險手帳接受今天的拜訪。
welcome.note2.en: Furniture, clothes and keepsakes stay with your passport. Decorate, sit or rest at home. Accept today’s resident visit in the adventure journal when you want company.

welcome.note3.zh-TW: 森林裡有松鼠、藍鵲與貓頭鷹，會隨台灣時間輪替。山羌在每日 14:00–21:00 出現；其他時間有補遇步道，不必等到半夜。
welcome.note3.en: Squirrels, blue magpies and owls rotate by Taiwan time. Muntjacs appear daily from 14:00–21:00; a catch-up trail is available at other times. No late-night wait needed.

welcome.note4.zh-TW: 海灘可以散步、聽海，也能點貝殼收進背包。帶回小屋展示，或到海風小舖交換素材與擺飾；也能到花園種菜、灌溉稻田，或到池邊釣魚。
welcome.note4.en: Walk, listen to the waves and tap shells to collect them. Display finds at home or visit the Sea Breeze Shop to exchange materials and decor. You can also grow a garden, tend a rice paddy or fish by the pond.

welcome.how0.zh-TW: 在島嶼地圖點選地點即可前往；上方「回家」能直接回到自己的小屋。
welcome.how0.en: Tap a place on the island map to enter. Use Home in the top navigation to return to your cottage.

welcome.how1.zh-TW: 進入廣場，在布告欄寫下問候；按「看看廣場布告欄」可記錄第一個探索步驟。
welcome.how1.en: Enter the square and write a greeting on the noticeboard. Choose Read the noticeboard to record a first exploration step.

welcome.how2.zh-TW: 進入小屋後點家具互動；調整布置後記得儲存。居民拜訪可接受、稍後或婉拒。
welcome.how2.en: Tap furniture to interact in your cottage. Save after decorating. You may accept, defer or decline resident visits.

welcome.how3.zh-TW: 進入森林，選擇散步，再按「安靜觀察野生朋友」；想遇見山羌可走補遇步道。
welcome.how3.en: Enter the woods, take a walk, then choose Observe wildlife quietly. Use the catch-up trail to meet a muntjac.

welcome.how4.zh-TW: 選一個想先體驗的地方，按下方按鈕出發。導覽隨時能從地圖重新觀看。
welcome.how4.en: Choose a place below and set off. You can replay this tour from the map at any time.

welcome.gain0.zh-TW: 導覽不會代替你完成任務。親自探索五個角落後，可在冒險手帳領取初次冒險紀念卡。
welcome.gain0.en: The tour does not complete quests for you. Explore the five corners yourself, then claim your first adventure keepsake in the journal.

welcome.gain1.zh-TW: 問候會顯示給其他島民；任務是否完成、下一步去哪裡，都能在冒險手帳查看。
welcome.gain1.en: Other residents can see your greeting. The journal shows quest progress and where to go next.

welcome.gain2.zh-TW: 儲存的布置重新登入後仍保留；完成一次居民來訪聊天，可領取朋友來訪紀念卡。
welcome.gain2.en: Saved decor stays when you sign in again. Complete a resident visit conversation to earn a visitor keepsake.

welcome.gain3.zh-TW: 散步與觀察分別留下進度；完成森林與海灘的探索，可解鎖自然朋友紀念卡。
welcome.gain3.en: Walking and observation each record progress. Complete the woodland and beach activities to unlock a nature keepsake.

welcome.gain4.zh-TW: 紀念卡會留在冒險收藏，還能額外領一次島幣。島幣只在島內使用；不需要每日報到，也沒有缺席處罰。
welcome.gain4.en: Keepsake cards stay in your collection and offer a one-time island coin bonus. Coins are only for island use. No daily attendance or absence penalty.

welcome.finish.en: Finish the tour and set off

welcome.detail0.zh-TW: 讓剛登島的朋友認識你。發佈後會顯示在榕樹廣場布告欄。
welcome.detail0.en: Introduce yourself to new arrivals. Your greeting will appear on the Banyan Square noticeboard.

welcome.detail3.zh-TW: 招呼已保存，島民可以在廣場看到。
welcome.detail3.en: Greeting saved. Residents can see it in the square.

welcome.detail8.zh-TW: 紀念卡會保存在冒險收藏，不會兌換成金幣。
welcome.detail8.en: Keepsake cards stay in your adventure collection; they are not exchangeable for coins.

welcome.detail9.zh-TW: 接受拜訪並回小屋聊天
welcome.detail9.en: Accept a visit and chat at home

welcome.detail10.zh-TW: 到觀景坡或補遇步道看看山羌
welcome.detail10.en: Meet a muntjac at the overlook or catch-up trail

welcome.detail11.zh-TW: 接受後回小屋，找到朋友並分享喜歡的角落；完成後回手帳領取朋友來訪紀念卡。
welcome.detail11.en: After accepting, go home and share your favorite corner with your visitor. Return to the journal to claim your visitor keepsake.

welcome.streetPlay.zh-TW: 喝咖啡、閱讀，逛逛生活街的主題空間。
welcome.streetPlay.en: Enjoy coffee, reading and the living street’s themed spaces.

welcome.sportsPlay.zh-TW: 進入運動場景，選一項運動；也可以到果嶺試一次推球。
welcome.sportsPlay.en: Enter a sports scene, choose an activity, or try putting on the green.

welcome.nomadPlay.zh-TW: 選一個空位坐下，再選工作、閱讀或休息；咖啡角落能拿飲品。
welcome.nomadPlay.en: Choose an empty seat, then work, read or rest. Pick up a drink at the Coffee Corner.

collection.intro.zh-TW: 把路上的小發現，變成家裡喜歡的角落。
collection.intro.en: Turn little discoveries into a favorite corner at home.

collection.beachNote.zh-TW: 每天有六枚屬於你的貝殼。點畫面上的貝殼收進背包，不會搶走其他島民的發現。
collection.beachNote.en: Six shells are yours to discover each day. Tap a shell in the scene to collect it without taking another resident’s find.

collection.forestNote.zh-TW: 只拾取步道上的落葉與松果，不採摘活植物。今天有三份小發現。
collection.forestNote.en: Collect only fallen leaves and pinecones on the trail, leaving living plants untouched. Three little finds await today.

collection.reset.zh-TW: 每天台灣時間 00:00 更新；沒有連續登入要求，錯過不扣分。
collection.reset.en: Finds refresh at 00:00 Taiwan time. No streaks, attendance requirement or absence penalty.

collection.emptyScene.zh-TW: 今天的小發現都收好了。可以回家展示，或明天再來散步。
collection.emptyScene.en: You have collected today’s finds. Display them at home or return for another walk tomorrow.

collection.success.zh-TW: 已保存。背包、島幣與紀錄已一起更新。
collection.success.en: Saved. Your backpack, coins and ledger were updated together.

collection.replay.zh-TW: 這筆操作已完成，沒有重複扣款或發放物品。
collection.replay.en: This action was already completed. Nothing was charged or granted twice.

collection.conflict.zh-TW: 物品、餘額或展示位置已變動；本次沒有扣款。請重新開啟背包再試。
collection.conflict.en: Your items, balance or display changed. Nothing was charged. Reopen your backpack and try again.

collection.unavailable.zh-TW: 收藏功能暫時無法使用，原本的遊戲資料仍保留。
collection.unavailable.en: Collections are temporarily unavailable. Your existing game data is preserved.

collection.login.zh-TW: 先登入島民證，讓收藏跟著你保存。
collection.login.en: Sign in with your resident passport to save your collection.

collection.signin.en: Sign in or get a passport

collection.invalid.zh-TW: 請使用頁面上的操作，再試一次。
collection.invalid.en: Please use the controls on this page and try again.

collection.expired.zh-TW: 這個操作已過期，請重新開啟原頁再試。
collection.expired.en: This action has expired. Reopen the page to try again.

collection.reserved.zh-TW: 展示中的物品會保留；先從展示架收回，才能交換或贈送。
collection.reserved.en: Displayed items are reserved. Return them to your backpack before exchanging or gifting.

collection.emptyBag.zh-TW: 背包還很輕。去海邊拾起第一枚貝殼吧。
collection.emptyBag.en: Your backpack is still light. Find your first shell at the beach.

collection.emptyShelf.zh-TW: 還沒有展示物品。從背包選一件喜歡的收藏，放進四個展示位置。
collection.emptyShelf.en: Nothing is on display yet. Choose a keepsake in your backpack and place it in one of four slots.

collection.short.zh-TW: 目前數量不足，先去探索或收回展示中的物品。
collection.short.en: Not enough available yet. Explore or return displayed items to your backpack.

collection.poor.zh-TW: 島幣不足，可以交換多餘素材，或領取冒險獎勵。
collection.poor.en: Not enough coins. Exchange spare materials or claim an adventure reward.

collection.virtual.zh-TW: 完全虛擬的島內商店。島幣不能購買、提領或兌換現金；沒有真實付款。
collection.virtual.en: A fully virtual island shop. Coins cannot be bought, withdrawn or exchanged for cash. No real payments.

collection.legacy.zh-TW: 原有家具與服裝照常可用，不必重新購買。這裡販售的是新增的展示收藏。
collection.legacy.en: Your existing furniture and clothes remain available without repurchasing. This shop offers new display keepsakes.

collection.giftNote.zh-TW: 送出後會從你的背包移到對方背包。請核對暱稱與島民編號。
collection.giftNote.en: The item moves from your backpack to theirs. Check the nickname and resident ID before sending.

collection.noMember.zh-TW: 找不到這位島民，或編號是你自己。請核對對方島民證。
collection.noMember.en: That resident was not found, or the ID is your own. Check your friend’s passport.

collection.giftSuccess.zh-TW: 小禮物已送進朋友的背包。
collection.giftSuccess.en: Your gift is now in your friend’s backpack.

collection.rewards.en: Bring adventure memories into daily life

collection.rewardNote.zh-TW: 每張已領取的冒險紀念卡，可額外領一次 10 島幣。原紀念卡會保留，不會被消耗。
collection.rewardNote.en: Each claimed adventure keepsake offers a one-time bonus of 10 coins. The original keepsake stays with you.

collection.claim.zh-TW: 領取這張紀念卡的島幣

collection.allClaimed.zh-TW: 目前可領的島幣都已收好。新的冒險回憶會出現在這裡。
collection.allClaimed.en: All available bonuses have been claimed. New adventure memories will appear here.

collection.oldNote.zh-TW: 舊紀念卡、家具解鎖與故事回憶仍在原本的位置。下方入口可繼續查看。
collection.oldNote.en: Your original cards, furniture unlocks and story memories remain in their original places. Use the links below to visit them.

collection.noHistory.zh-TW: 還沒有收支或交換紀錄。第一枚貝殼會替你開始記錄。
collection.noHistory.en: No activity yet. Your first shell will start the story.

collection.scallopNote.zh-TW: 溫柔的扇形紋路，適合收藏，也能製成海風吊飾。
collection.scallopNote.en: Soft fan-shaped ridges. Keep one or craft a seaside mobile.

collection.spiralNote.zh-TW: 小小的螺旋，像把海浪的聲音捲在裡面。
collection.spiralNote.en: A tiny spiral that seems to hold the sound of the waves.

collection.clamNote.zh-TW: 圓潤的藍灰色殼面，帶回家留住一點海色。
collection.clamNote.en: A rounded blue-gray shell to bring a little sea color home.

collection.pineconeNote.zh-TW: 只撿自然落下的松果，留住森林的小小形狀。
collection.pineconeNote.en: A naturally fallen pinecone, a little woodland shape to keep.

collection.leafNote.zh-TW: 步道邊的完整落葉，可以製作植物相框。
collection.leafNote.en: A fallen leaf from the trail, ready for a botanical frame.

collection.mobileNote.zh-TW: 用三枚奶油扇貝製成，放上展示架就有海邊的心情。
collection.mobileNote.en: Made from three cream scallops. A seaside mood for your display shelf.

collection.frameNote.zh-TW: 用兩片金色落葉製成，替小屋留一個森林角落。
collection.frameNote.en: Made from two golden leaves, a woodland corner for your cottage.

collection.vaseNote.zh-TW: 霧面陶器與一枝小葉子，適合安靜的小屋。
collection.vaseNote.en: Matte ceramic and a little sprig for a quiet cottage.

collection.trayNote.zh-TW: 一只淺淺的藤盤，把喜歡的日常留在眼前。
collection.trayNote.en: A shallow woven tray, a little reminder of favorite days.

collection.beachFooter.zh-TW: 海浪會把新的小發現帶到沙灘。喜歡的貝殼，可以帶回小屋收藏。
collection.beachFooter.en: The waves bring little discoveries to shore. Bring a favorite shell home to keep.

garden.intro.zh-TW: 三格菜圃、一格稻田。種下、澆水，再去島上散步；作物會在離線時繼續長大。
garden.intro.en: Three garden beds and one rice paddy. Plant, water, then wander the island. Crops keep growing while you are away.

garden.gentle.zh-TW: 只需澆一次水。成熟後會一直等你，不會枯萎、腐壞或因缺席扣分。
garden.gentle.en: Water once. Ripe crops wait for you without wilting, spoiling or absence penalties.

garden.starterNote.zh-TW: 香草、胡蘿蔔、番茄各兩包，稻種一包。每位島民可領一次，之後可用島幣補種。
garden.starterNote.en: Two herb, carrot and tomato seed packs each, plus one rice seed pack. Once per resident; more seeds are available for island coins.

garden.empty.zh-TW: 空地，等你種下第一顆種子
garden.empty.en: An empty plot for your next seed

garden.noSeed.zh-TW: 目前沒有適合這格的種子。先領種子包，或到海風小舖看看。
garden.noSeed.en: No suitable seed is available. Claim your starter pack or visit the shop.

garden.variety.zh-TW: 種出香草、胡蘿蔔與番茄，就能在商店發現向日葵種子。
garden.variety.en: Harvest herbs, carrots and tomatoes to discover sunflower seeds in the shop.

garden.pondIntro.zh-TW: 在池邊坐一會，二十秒後可以收竿。沒有快反應要求，晚一點回來也不會錯過。
garden.pondIntro.en: Sit by the pond. Your line is ready after twenty seconds, with no reflex test or missed catch if you return later.

garden.waiting.zh-TW: 魚漂正輕輕晃動，稍後再看看。
garden.waiting.en: The float is drifting gently. Check again in a moment.

garden.catchReady.en: Ready to reel in. There is no rush.

garden.pondRules.zh-TW: 每天最多六次新下竿，收竿後休息兩分鐘。沒有魚餌費用；養殖與繁殖尚未開放。
garden.pondRules.en: Up to six new casts per Taiwan day, with a two-minute rest after reeling in. No bait cost. Breeding and aquaculture are not available yet.

garden.rest.zh-TW: 池邊先休息一下，再開始下一次。
garden.rest.en: Rest by the pond before casting again.

garden.limit.zh-TW: 今天已經釣過六次。可以去花園看看，明天再來。
garden.limit.en: You have fished six times today. Visit the garden and return another day.

garden.tradeIntro.zh-TW: 你先放一件物品暫存，對方核對後再交出一件。雙方的背包會一起更新；不使用島幣，也沒有真實付款。
garden.tradeIntro.en: Set aside one item. Your friend reviews the offer and gives one item in return. Both backpacks update together, without coins or real payments.

garden.confirmPost.zh-TW: 確認暫存物品並送出邀請
garden.confirmPost.en: Set aside this item and send offer

garden.postNote.zh-TW: 送出後，交出的物品會暫存，不會同時留在可用背包。對方有二十四小時接受；你可隨時撤回並取回物品。
garden.postNote.en: Your offered item is held aside and removed from available inventory. Your friend has twenty-four hours to accept. You may cancel and reclaim it at any time.

garden.emptyTrade.zh-TW: 還沒有交換邀請。可以先到背包看看多餘的素材。
garden.emptyTrade.en: No exchange offers yet. Check your backpack for spare finds.

garden.expired.zh-TW: 邀請已過期；發起人可取回暫存物品。
garden.expired.en: This offer expired. The sender can reclaim the held item.

garden.accept.zh-TW: 確認交出一件並完成交換
garden.accept.en: Give one and complete this exchange

garden.decline.en: Decline and return the offered item

garden.noItem.zh-TW: 目前沒有可交換的物品，或需要的物品還不足。展示中的物品需先收回背包。
garden.noItem.en: No item is available, or the required item is missing. Return displayed items to your backpack before trading.

garden.badMember.zh-TW: 請核對對方島民編號；不能和自己交換相同物品。
garden.badMember.en: Check the resident ID. You cannot trade with yourself or exchange identical items.

garden.saved.zh-TW: 已保存，背包與進度已一起更新。
garden.saved.en: Saved. Your backpack and progress were updated together.

garden.replay.zh-TW: 這次操作已完成，沒有重複消耗或發放。
garden.replay.en: This action was already completed. Nothing was spent or granted twice.

garden.conflict.zh-TW: 進度、物品或邀請已改變；本次沒有消耗物品。請重新整理再試。
garden.conflict.en: Progress, items or the offer changed. Nothing was consumed. Refresh and try again.

garden.oldToken.zh-TW: 操作已過期，請重新開啟這個頁面。
garden.oldToken.en: This action expired. Reopen this page.

garden.invalid.en: Please use the controls on this page.

garden.unavailable.zh-TW: 田園功能暫時無法使用，原本的資料仍保留。
garden.unavailable.en: Garden features are temporarily unavailable. Your existing data is preserved.

garden.login.zh-TW: 登入島民證，照顧自己的花園與收藏。
garden.login.en: Sign in with your passport to care for your garden and collection.

garden.signin.en: Sign in or get a passport

collection.sourceGarden.zh-TW: 來源：自己的花園或稻田
collection.sourceGarden.en: Source: your garden or rice paddy

collection.seed_herbNote.zh-TW: 種下後澆一次水，五分鐘後可收成。
collection.seed_herbNote.en: Plant and water once. Ready to harvest in five minutes.

collection.seed_carrotNote.zh-TW: 種下後澆一次水，十五分鐘後可收成。
collection.seed_carrotNote.en: Plant and water once. Ready to harvest in fifteen minutes.

collection.seed_tomatoNote.zh-TW: 種下後澆一次水，三十分鐘後可收成。
collection.seed_tomatoNote.en: Plant and water once. Ready to harvest in thirty minutes.

collection.seed_riceNote.zh-TW: 種在第四格稻田，灌水後六十分鐘可收成。
collection.seed_riceNote.en: Plant in paddy plot four. Ready sixty minutes after watering.

collection.seed_sunflowerNote.zh-TW: 收成過香草、胡蘿蔔與番茄後解鎖；澆水後四十五分鐘開花。
collection.seed_sunflowerNote.en: Unlock after harvesting herbs, carrots and tomatoes. Blooms forty-five minutes after watering.

collection.herbNote.zh-TW: 自己種出的清香，可展示、換島幣、交換或送朋友。
collection.herbNote.en: Homegrown fragrance to display, sell, trade or give to a friend.

collection.carrotNote.zh-TW: 一顆種子收成兩份，讓小小菜圃有真實的回饋。
collection.carrotNote.en: One seed yields two carrots, a little reward from your garden.

collection.tomatoNote.zh-TW: 成熟後會一直等你，不會因晚登入而腐壞。
collection.tomatoNote.en: Ripe tomatoes wait for you and never spoil because you signed in late.

collection.riceNote.zh-TW: 從小小稻田收成的稻穗，可帶回小屋展示。
collection.riceNote.en: Harvested from your little paddy, ready for a cottage display.

collection.sunflowerNote.zh-TW: 種過三種蔬菜後的新發現，替小屋留一束陽光。
collection.sunflowerNote.en: A discovery after growing three crops, a little sunshine for your cottage.

collection.silverfishNote.zh-TW: 池邊的遊戲收藏，可展示、交換或贈送，不含真實交易。
collection.silverfishNote.en: A virtual pond keepsake to display, trade or gift, with no real-world transaction.

collection.pondcarpNote.zh-TW: 釣起後收進共用背包；養殖與繁殖尚未開放。
collection.pondcarpNote.en: A catch for your shared backpack. Breeding and aquaculture are not available yet.

collection.locked.zh-TW: 收成香草、胡蘿蔔、番茄後解鎖。
collection.locked.en: Unlock by harvesting herbs, carrots and tomatoes.

garden.gardenQuestTitle.en: A promise between garden and woodland

garden.gardenQuestNote.zh-TW: 收成一回、觀察野生朋友，再到池邊收竿。
garden.gardenQuestNote.en: Harvest once, observe a wild friend, then reel in a pond find.

observatory.welcome.zh-TW: 門開著，問題也可以慢慢問。
observatory.welcome.en: The door is open. There is time for your questions.

observatory.intro.zh-TW: 這裡從島上的一杯咖啡、一籃胡蘿蔔開始，觀察生活如何連在一起。沒有考試，也不用每天報到。
observatory.intro.en: Start with a cup of coffee and a basket of carrots. Discover how island life connects, without tests or daily check-ins.

observatory.role.zh-TW: 島嶼經濟學家 · 喜歡先聽生活故事
observatory.role.en: Island economist · Every observation starts with a story

observatory.today.en: What is happening on the island?

observatory.why.zh-TW: 為什麼商品價格會變動？

observatory.hello.zh-TW: 嗨，我是楓教授！我喜歡先逛農場，再坐下來聽咖啡師的故事。你想從哪裡開始？
observatory.hello.en: Hello, I am Professor Maple! I like visiting farms and listening to café stories. Where would you like to start?

observatory.todayText.zh-TW: 今天研究所剛開門。我們先認識供給與需求；正式的每週市場事件與經濟週報還在準備中。你可以先到花園看看自己種下的作物。
observatory.todayText.en: Our research house has just opened. Let us start with supply and demand. Weekly market events and the economic bulletin are still being prepared. Visit your garden to see what you have planted.

observatory.whyText.zh-TW: 想像胡蘿蔔豐收了，想買的人數卻一樣：市場上可賣的胡蘿蔔增加，價格通常面臨下行壓力。若大家突然想喝咖啡，供給暫時沒變，咖啡價格通常面臨上行壓力。其他條件是否改變，也要一起看。
observatory.whyText.en: Imagine a carrot harvest grows while the number of buyers stays the same. More carrots for sale usually put downward pressure on prices. If more people want coffee while supply stays unchanged, prices usually face upward pressure. We must also check what else has changed.

observatory.indexText.zh-TW: BBI 將觀察島嶼經濟活動，BCPI 將追蹤固定商品籃子的價格。V90.2 才會提供可重現的模擬資料與正式快照；目前沒有已發布的指數或漲跌率。
observatory.indexText.en: BBI will track island economic activity. BCPI will follow the price of a fixed basket of goods. Reproducible simulated data and official snapshots arrive in V90.2. No indices or rates of change have been published yet.

observatory.experimentText.zh-TW: 先用一個故事試想：胡蘿蔔變多了，買的人沒有變，價格可能怎麼走？你可以翻開下面的觀察卡，看看不同條件。這是概念故事，不會改變花園產量、商店售價或你的島幣。可操作的模擬市場會在 V90.2 開放。
observatory.experimentText.en: Try a story: more carrots arrive, but the number of buyers stays the same. What might happen to prices? Open an observation card below to explore the conditions. This is a concept story; it does not change crops, shop prices or your coins. The playable simulated market arrives in V90.2.

observatory.supply.zh-TW: 胡蘿蔔大豐收 · 供給增加

observatory.supplyText.zh-TW: 需求不變時，更多胡蘿蔔競相出售，價格通常受到下行壓力。買菜居民可能受益，農夫每份收入則可能減少。
observatory.supplyText.en: With demand unchanged, more carrots compete for buyers and prices usually face downward pressure. Shoppers may benefit while farmers may earn less per carrot.

observatory.demand.zh-TW: 島嶼咖啡節 · 需求增加

observatory.demandText.zh-TW: 供給短期不變時，更多遊客想買咖啡，價格通常受到上行壓力。咖啡館可能賣得更多，買咖啡的居民則可能花得更多。
observatory.demandText.en: With short-term supply unchanged, more visitors wanting coffee usually put upward pressure on prices. Cafés may sell more while residents may pay more for a cup.

observatory.storyLabel.zh-TW: 概念故事 · 非市場事件或玩家統計
observatory.storyLabel.en: Concept stories · Not market events or player statistics

observatory.pendingText.zh-TW: 有資料來源、期間與計算版本之後，才會放上數字。未來的模擬指數會清楚標示資料性質。
observatory.pendingText.en: Numbers will appear only when their source, period and calculation version are available. Future simulated indices will be clearly labelled.

observatory.room.zh-TW: 木質研究室，圓窗旁有書桌、觀察卡與楓教授
observatory.room.en: A wooden study with round windows, a desk, observation cards and Professor Maple

observatory.roomHint.zh-TW: 點楓教授聊天，或翻開桌上的觀察卡。隨時可以離開。
observatory.roomHint.en: Talk with Professor Maple or open a card on the desk. Leave whenever you like.

observatory.mapHint.zh-TW: 走進木石小研究所，與楓教授聊聊生活中的價格
observatory.mapHint.en: Visit the little wood-and-stone research house and talk with Professor Maple about everyday prices

economy.label.zh-TW: 官方島嶼模擬 · 非玩家市場統計
economy.label.en: Official island simulation · Not player market statistics

economy.why.en: Why did it change this week?

economy.harvestStory.zh-TW: 本期胡蘿蔔供給增加 40%，需求不變。價格模型因此向下調整；模擬產出上升，但成交量受需求限制。
economy.harvestStory.en: Carrot supply rises 40% while demand stays unchanged. The price model moves down; simulated output rises, but demand limits matched quantity.

economy.festivalStory.zh-TW: 咖啡節使咖啡需求增加 40%，供給因增產增加 20%。需求增幅較大，模型價格上升，成交量與咖啡館銷量也增加。
economy.festivalStory.en: Coffee demand rises 40% and production raises supply 20%. Demand rises faster, so the model price increases along with matched quantity and café volume.

economy.buildingStory.zh-TW: 施工使木材需求增加 30%，供給暫時不變。模型價格上升；成交量受到供給限制。
economy.buildingStory.en: Construction raises wood demand 30% while supply stays unchanged. The model price rises; supply limits matched quantity.

economy.stableStory.zh-TW: 本期沒有供需衝擊，所有商品回到基期條件。與上期的漲跌仍可能反映上一事件結束。
economy.stableStory.en: There is no supply or demand shock this period. All goods return to base conditions. Weekly changes can still reflect the end of the previous event.

economy.expiry.zh-TW: 事件只作用於這一週，下週按排程重新從基期計算，不會無限疊加。
economy.expiry.en: An event lasts one week. The next period recalculates from the base; shocks never accumulate indefinitely.

economy.previousEnd.zh-TW: 週增率同時包含本期事件開始及上期事件結束；下方可比較兩期資料。
economy.previousEnd.en: Weekly changes include both this event starting and the previous event ending. Compare the two snapshots below.

economy.harvestBenefit.zh-TW: 買菜居民的成本較低；農夫每份收入承壓。可以留意需求，再決定分批採收或交換。
economy.harvestBenefit.en: Shoppers face lower costs; farmers face pressure on revenue per carrot. Observe demand before harvesting or exchanging in batches.

economy.festivalBenefit.zh-TW: 咖啡館銷售量增加，咖啡原料供應者可能受益；喝咖啡的居民面臨較高價格。可以預先備料或選擇其他飲品。
economy.festivalBenefit.en: Cafés sell more and coffee suppliers may benefit; residents face higher coffee prices. Preparing inputs or choosing other drinks are possible responses.

economy.buildingBenefit.zh-TW: 木材供應者可能受益，施工與家具製作者承受材料成本壓力。可以分批採購或延後非必要工程。
economy.buildingBenefit.en: Wood suppliers may benefit while builders and furniture makers face input cost pressure. Buying in batches or delaying optional work are possible responses.

economy.stableBenefit.zh-TW: 居民可以按自己的步調探索。這裡沒有每日測驗、排名或懲罰。
economy.stableBenefit.en: Residents can explore at their own pace. There are no daily tests, rankings or penalties.

economy.prices.zh-TW: 固定商品籃子與本期價格

economy.priceUnit.zh-TW: 價格單位：模擬島幣／份；數量單位：模型份／週
economy.priceUnit.en: Prices: simulated coins per unit; quantities: model units per week

economy.historyNote.zh-TW: 僅顯示已到期的模擬期間，最多最近 13 期；不是實際市場歷史。
economy.historyNote.en: Only simulated periods that have started are shown, up to the latest 13; this is not actual market history.

economy.method.zh-TW: 打開研究筆記：公式與來源
economy.method.en: Open the research notes: formulas and source

economy.formula.zh-TW: 價格 = 基期價格 × √（需求比率／供給比率），限制在基期價格的 0.5～2 倍。模型成交量 = 供給與需求的較小值。這是簡化教學模型，不代表真實市場的精確預測。
economy.formula.en: Price = base price × √(demand ratio / supply ratio), bounded at 0.5–2× the base price. Matched quantity = the smaller of supply and demand. This is a simplified learning model, not a precise real-market forecast.

economy.bbiMethod.zh-TW: BBI = 100 ×（成交量比率 × 40% + 產出比率 × 25% + 咖啡館銷量比率 × 20% + 固定基價加權的 NPC 消費量比率 × 15%）。每個比率都相對基期；這是重疊活動指標的組合，不是 GDP 或交易金額加總。
economy.bbiMethod.en: BBI = 100 × (matched-volume ratio × 40% + output ratio × 25% + café-volume ratio × 20% + fixed-base-price-weighted NPC consumption-volume ratio × 15%). Each ratio is relative to the base. This is a composite of overlapping activity indicators, not GDP or a sum of transaction amounts.

economy.bcpiMethod.zh-TW: BCPI = 100 × Σ（本期價格 × 固定籃子數量）／Σ（基期價格 × 固定籃子數量）。籃子與基期價格不隨事件改變。
economy.bcpiMethod.en: BCPI = 100 × Σ(current price × fixed basket quantity) / Σ(base price × fixed basket quantity). The basket and base prices do not change with events.

economy.contributions.zh-TW: BBI 相較基期的成分貢獻（指數點）
economy.contributions.en: BBI component contributions from base (index points)

economy.sourceNote.zh-TW: 來源：伺服器共用的確定性模擬。每週一 00:00（台灣時間）換期，首次讀取會保存缺少的快照；不需要玩家登入次數，也不會讀寫玩家資產。
economy.sourceNote.en: Source: shared deterministic server simulation. Periods change Monday at 00:00 Taiwan time. The first read saves missing snapshots. Login counts are not used and player assets are not read or written.

economy.raw.zh-TW: 查看已保存的原始資料（JSON）

economy.labNote.zh-TW: 這是你的獨立試算，與官方每週快照分開。不改變商店價格、產量、島幣或背包；重設就回到相同的基期。
economy.labNote.en: This is your separate experiment, independent of official weekly snapshots. It does not change shop prices, crop output, coins or inventory. Reset returns to the same base.

economy.experimentResult.zh-TW: 實驗結果 · 非官方指數

economy.labModel.zh-TW: 一般衝擊沿用事件設定；加強衝擊把供需相對基期的增幅加倍，每次都重新計算，不會累積。
economy.labModel.en: Standard shocks use the event definition. Stronger shocks double supply/demand increases from the base. Every selection recalculates without accumulating.

economy.unavailable.zh-TW: 研究資料暫時無法讀取，請稍後再試。原本的島嶼活動仍可使用。
economy.unavailable.en: Research data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later. Existing island activities remain available.

economy.openLab.en: Visit the supply and demand lab

economy.weeklyPending.zh-TW: 經濟週報與胡蘿蔔支線任務將在 V90.3 開放。
economy.weeklyPending.en: The economic bulletin and carrot side quest arrive in V90.3.

economy.currentTalk.zh-TW: 這週的價格與活動可以在觀察桌一起看。點開「本週為什麼變動」，再比較各種商品。
economy.currentTalk.en: Explore this week’s prices and activity together at the economy desk. Open “Why did it change this week?” and compare the goods.

economy.indexTalk.zh-TW: BBI 看活動量，BCPI 看固定籃子的價格。兩者是共用的模擬指數；我把公式、基期與快照都留在研究筆記裡了。
economy.indexTalk.en: BBI follows activity volume; BCPI follows fixed-basket prices. Both are shared simulated indices. Their formulas, base and snapshots are in the research notes.

economy.labTalk.zh-TW: 到實驗桌選擇豐收、咖啡節或施工，看看供給、需求與價格如何一起變動。想重來，隨時可以重設。
economy.labTalk.en: At the lab, choose a harvest, coffee festival or construction event to see supply, demand and prices change together. Reset whenever you like.

economy.annualMethod.zh-TW: 年增率需有滿 12 個月的週資料；比較去年同日或之前最近一期。週增率 = 本期／上期 − 1；相較基期 = 指數／100 − 1。
economy.annualMethod.en: Year-over-year requires 12 months of weekly data, using the nearest period on or before the same date last year. Weekly change = current / previous − 1; base change = index / 100 − 1.

economy.modelBounds.zh-TW: 調整的是模型商品市場；島上現有商店與玩家交易仍沿用原系統。
economy.modelBounds.en: Only the model market changes; existing island shops and player exchanges keep their current rules.

story.intro.zh-TW: 一張廣場公告，連起農場、咖啡館與島上的價格。隨時可以離開，下次再繼續。
story.intro.en: A square notice connects the farm, café and island prices. Leave whenever you like and continue next time.

story.square.zh-TW: 廣場公告：胡蘿蔔變便宜了

story.squareText.zh-TW: 這份模擬案例裡，胡蘿蔔豐收、供給增加，想買的人卻沒有變。一起去問問楓教授吧。
story.squareText.en: In this simulated case, a plentiful harvest increases carrot supply while demand stays unchanged. Let us ask Professor Maple.

story.mapleText.zh-TW: 價格變動不只有一個原因。我們先到農場，看看這次是供給還是需求改變。
story.mapleText.en: Prices can change for many reasons. Visit the farm to see whether supply or demand changed this time.

story.farm.zh-TW: 農場線索：多了好多胡蘿蔔

story.farmText.zh-TW: 這次案例的胡蘿蔔供給由 100 份增加到 140 份，需求仍是 100 份。這些是案例數據，不會改變你的花園產量。
story.farmText.en: Case supply grows from 100 to 140 units while demand stays at 100. These are case figures and do not change your garden output.

story.cafeText.zh-TW: Hugo 說：「胡蘿蔔便宜時，做胡蘿蔔點心的材料成本可能減少；但農夫每份收入也可能降低。不同居民感受到的改變不一樣。」
story.cafeText.en: Hugo says, “Cheaper carrots may reduce the ingredient cost of carrot snacks, while farmers may earn less per carrot. Residents experience the change differently.”

story.explain.zh-TW: 回到觀測站，說說你的發現
story.explain.en: Back at the observatory, share your observation

story.explainText.zh-TW: 這次案例中，哪個解釋最符合看到的線索？選擇只是聊天，不會扣款或阻擋探索。
story.explainText.en: Which explanation fits the clues in this case? This is a conversation, without charges or restrictions on exploration.

story.supply.zh-TW: 供給增加，需求不變，價格承受下行壓力
story.supply.en: Supply increased while demand stayed unchanged, putting downward pressure on price

story.demand.zh-TW: 只有需求增加，所以價格下降
story.demand.en: Only demand increased, so price fell

story.unsure.zh-TW: 我還不確定，請教授解釋
story.unsure.en: I am not sure; please explain

story.right.zh-TW: 你把線索連起來了：這次供給增加、需求不變，價格面臨下行壓力。實際市場仍要一起觀察其他條件。
story.right.en: You connected the clues: increased supply with unchanged demand puts downward pressure on price. In real markets, other conditions also matter.

story.gentle.zh-TW: 沒關係，我們一起看：這次改變的是供給，從 100 增加到 140，需求沒有變。這使價格面臨下行壓力。你仍然完成了這段探索。
story.gentle.en: That is all right. Supply changed from 100 to 140 while demand stayed unchanged, putting downward pressure on price. You have still completed this exploration.

story.continue.en: Record the clue and visit the next stop

story.claimed.zh-TW: 紀念徽章已收藏，不會重複發放。
story.claimed.en: Your badge is collected and will not be issued twice.

story.case.zh-TW: 本任務固定使用的模擬案例期間

story.price.zh-TW: 案例胡蘿蔔價格（模擬島幣／份）

story.login.zh-TW: 登入島民證後即可保存探索進度。
story.login.en: Sign in with a resident passport to save progress.

story.invalid.zh-TW: 這次操作已失效或不符合目前進度，請回任務地點再試。
story.invalid.en: This action expired or does not match your progress. Return to the quest location and try again.

story.unavailable.zh-TW: 故事暫時無法開啟，原本的島嶼活動仍可使用。
story.unavailable.en: This story is temporarily unavailable. Existing island activities remain available.

story.newsNote.zh-TW: 文章與數字綁定同一份已保存的官方模擬快照，並非真實玩家市場統計。
story.newsNote.en: This article and its numbers use the same saved official simulation snapshot, not real player market statistics.

story.newsHarvest.zh-TW: 農場籃子裝得更滿，咖啡館開始構思胡蘿蔔點心。農夫與買菜的居民，對同一個價格有不同感受。
story.newsHarvest.en: Farm baskets are fuller and the café imagines carrot snacks. Farmers and shoppers experience the same price differently.

story.newsFestival.zh-TW: 咖啡節讓吧台忙了起來。多備咖啡豆有幫助，但需求跑得比供給更快。
story.newsFestival.en: The coffee festival keeps the counter busy. Preparing more beans helps, but demand grows faster than supply.

story.newsBuilding.zh-TW: 新工程需要木材，家具製作者也開始重新安排材料清單。
story.newsBuilding.en: New construction needs wood, and furniture makers revisit their material lists.

story.newsStable.zh-TW: 市集回到平常的節奏，居民慢慢採買。上一個事件結束，仍可能讓週變化出現正負數。
story.newsStable.en: The market returns to its usual pace. Residents shop calmly, though the end of the last event can still produce weekly changes.

story.prices.zh-TW: 主要商品價格與週變化

story.noCase.zh-TW: 胡蘿蔔案例尚未開始，請稍後再來。
story.noCase.en: The carrot case has not started yet. Please return later.

story.questNote.zh-TW: 跟著公告拜訪教授、農場與咖啡館，慢慢理解價格。
story.questNote.en: Follow the notice to the professor, farm and café, and explore prices at your own pace.

farm.intro.zh-TW: 把花園的收成，帶進居民的日常。先看清條件，再決定要不要接單。
farm.intro.en: Bring your garden harvest into residents’ daily lives. Review the terms before deciding whether to accept.

farm.terms.zh-TW: 接單不扣作物；交付時才扣除可用庫存。接單後數量與報酬固定，14 天內可以交付或免費取消。
farm.terms.en: Accepting does not consume crops. Delivery uses available inventory. Quantity and reward stay fixed after acceptance; deliver within14days or cancel freely.

farm.bounds.zh-TW: 每帳號每週最多三張新訂單，同時最多三張有效訂單。沒有強制登入、排名或逾期扣款。
farm.bounds.en: Each account has at most three new offers per week and three active orders. No attendance requirements, rankings or late penalties.

farm.carrotUse.zh-TW: Hugo 想替咖啡館準備一份胡蘿蔔點心。
farm.carrotUse.en: Hugo wants to prepare carrot snacks for the café.

farm.herbUse.zh-TW: Hugo 想用花園香草為飲品添一點清香。
farm.herbUse.en: Hugo wants garden herbs to add fragrance to the café drinks.

farm.tomatoUse.zh-TW: 餐飲創業嘉賓 Mika 正在準備簡單的島嶼午餐。
farm.tomatoUse.en: Mika, the food-business guest, is preparing a simple island lunch.

farm.baseFormula.zh-TW: 基礎報酬 = 原商店回收價 × 1.25，四捨五入至整數。總報酬 = 每份報酬 × 數量。原商店價格不變。
farm.baseFormula.en: Base unit reward = original shop sell price ×1.25, rounded to an integer. Total reward = unit reward × quantity. Existing shop prices stay unchanged.

farm.simFormula.zh-TW: 報酬依模擬情境設定，不是玩家自由市場價格。每份報酬 = 原回收價 × 1.25 × 情境係數，四捨五入後限制在原回收價的0.8～1.5倍整數範圍。
farm.simFormula.en: Rewards follow a simulated scenario, not a player free market. Unit reward = original sell price ×1.25× scenario factor, rounded and bounded within the integer range of0.8–1.5× the original sell price.

farm.source.en: Simulated period pinned to this quote

farm.expired.zh-TW: 已到期，沒有扣款或懲罰

farm.pending.zh-TW: 交付功能將在 V91.3 開放；目前接單不扣物品。
farm.pending.en: Delivery opens in V91.3. Accepting currently consumes no items.

farm.pricingPending.zh-TW: 目前使用固定基礎報酬；V91.2 將接上有上下限的情境報價。
farm.pricingPending.en: Offers currently use fixed base rewards. Bounded scenario pricing arrives in V91.2.

farm.replay.zh-TW: 這筆操作已完成，沒有重複扣貨或發放報酬。
farm.replay.en: This action was already completed. No duplicate items or rewards were processed.

farm.invalid.zh-TW: 這次操作已失效，或不符合訂單條件。請重新查看訂單；物品與島幣沒有被部分扣除。
farm.invalid.en: This action expired or no longer meets the order conditions. Review the order again. No partial item or coin changes were made.

farm.login.zh-TW: 登入島民證後，即可查看自己的居民訂單。
farm.login.en: Sign in with a resident passport to view your orders.

farm.unavailable.zh-TW: 訂單暫時無法使用，既有花園與收藏仍可使用。
farm.unavailable.en: Orders are temporarily unavailable. Your existing garden and collection remain available.

farm.empty.zh-TW: 目前沒有其他訂單紀錄。
farm.empty.en: There are no other order records yet.

farm.thankCarrot.zh-TW: Hugo 把胡蘿蔔放進點心籃：「謝謝，今天的菜單有著落了！」
farm.thankCarrot.en: Hugo puts the carrots in the snack basket. “Thank you! Today’s menu is ready.”

farm.thankHerb.zh-TW: Hugo 聞了聞香草：「這份清香，正好配下午的海風。」
farm.thankHerb.en: Hugo smells the herbs. “This fragrance goes perfectly with the afternoon sea breeze.”

farm.thankTomato.zh-TW: Mika 收好番茄：「簡單的午餐，也有農場的心意。」
farm.thankTomato.en: Mika collects the tomatoes. “A simple lunch carries a little care from the garden.”

farm.harvestExplain.zh-TW: 豐收情境下，胡蘿蔔供給較多，NPC 每份報價承壓。多種一些，不代表每份收入都增加。
farm.harvestExplain.en: In a harvest scenario, greater carrot supply puts pressure on the NPC unit quote. Growing more does not always increase income per unit.

farm.festivalExplain.zh-TW: 咖啡節情境增加相關餐飲需求，香草與番茄訂單量增加；報價仍受上限約束。
farm.festivalExplain.en: The coffee festival increases related food-service demand and herb/tomato order quantities. Quotes remain bounded.

farm.stableExplain.zh-TW: 目前按一般需求報價。你可以比較接單、一般回收與留在小屋展示的不同用途。
farm.stableExplain.en: Quotes reflect ordinary demand. Compare fulfilling orders, ordinary selling and keeping items for cottage display.

farm.separate.zh-TW: 訂單是真正的遊戲交付紀錄，與官方模擬 BBI／BCPI 分開，不會直接改寫指數。
farm.separate.en: Orders are real in-game delivery records, separate from the official simulated BBI/BCPI, and do not directly change those indices.

farm.reservation.zh-TW: 展示架上的物品不可交付；交換暫存的物品已從可用背包移出。不會重複使用同一份收成。
farm.reservation.en: Displayed items cannot be delivered. Items held for an exchange are already removed from available inventory. The same harvest cannot be used twice.

market.intro.zh-TW: 海邊生活街的小市集，把花園收成帶進居民的餐桌。
market.intro.en: A little market on Seaside Living Street, bringing garden harvests to residents’ tables.

market.orders.en: Meet residents, accept and deliver orders

market.quote.zh-TW: 本期 NPC 訂單報價／份
market.quote.en: This period’s NPC order quote / unit

market.none.zh-TW: 此商品不在模擬籃子內

market.distinction.zh-TW: 三種價格有不同用途。商店回收價維持原設定；NPC 報價依模擬情境設定，有數量及報酬上限；觀測站模擬價僅供觀察，不能直接成交。
market.distinction.en: These prices serve different purposes. Shop sell prices stay unchanged. NPC quotes follow bounded simulated scenarios. Observatory simulation prices are for observation, not executable trades.

market.locked.zh-TW: 已接受訂單請以訂單上的固定報酬為準。市集顯示新報價，不會追溯修改舊單。
market.locked.en: Accepted orders keep their fixed terms. New market quotes never rewrite an older order.

market.talk.zh-TW: 「帶來一點收成，今天的餐桌就多一點故事。」先看完整條件，再決定要不要接單。
market.talk.en: “Bring a little harvest, and today’s table has another story.” Review the full terms before accepting.

market.recordsNote.zh-TW: 以下只列已完成的居民訂單。作物與島幣紀錄使用既有帳本；官方模擬指數不因個人交付改變。
market.recordsNote.en: Only completed resident orders appear here. Produce and coin receipts use the existing ledger. Personal deliveries do not change the official simulated indices.

market.empty.zh-TW: 還沒有成交紀錄。可以先去花園種一點喜歡的作物。
market.empty.en: No completed orders yet. Start by growing something you like.

market.login.zh-TW: 登入島民證後可查看自己的庫存、報價與成交紀錄。訪客仍可逛市集。
market.login.en: Sign in with your resident passport to view your inventory, quotes and receipts. Visitors can still browse.

market.outage.zh-TW: 市場資料暫時無法使用。花園、小屋與既有生活功能仍可繼續。
market.outage.en: Market data is temporarily unavailable. The garden, cottage and existing activities remain available.

market.unit.zh-TW: 價格單位：虛擬島幣；數量單位：份
market.unit.en: Prices in virtual island coins; quantities in units

market.policy.zh-TW: 沒有玩家拍賣、銀行、借貸或真實付款。
market.policy.en: No player auction, banking, loans or real payments.

market.scene.zh-TW: 木製攤位、暖色遮棚與一籃籃收成的海邊市集
market.scene.en: A seaside market with wooden stalls, warm awnings and baskets of produce

market.pinHint.zh-TW: 逛農產攤位，看看報價，將收成交給需要的居民
market.pinHint.en: Browse produce stalls and quotes, then deliver harvests to residents

market.invalid.en: Invalid page. Please return to the market.

idea.title.en: Bear Atlas | About This Little Island

idea.lead.zh-TW: 留一個角落，給不用努力的自己；也留一點好奇，慢慢認識這個世界。
idea.lead.en: A little corner where you don’t have to try so hard, and a little curiosity to discover the world at your own pace.

idea.p1.zh-TW: Bear Atlas 的開始，是一個很簡單的念頭：
idea.p1.en: Bear Atlas began with a simple thought:

idea.p2.zh-TW: 如果有一個地方，可以照自己的喜好布置房間，出門遇見可愛的動物，沿著海岸散步，累了隨時回家，應該很好吧。
idea.p2.en: Wouldn’t it be lovely to have a place where you could decorate a room your way, meet animal neighbours, walk along the coast and come home whenever you felt tired?

idea.p3.zh-TW: 現實裡，我們常常有很多事情要做好。工作、生活、未來的打算，連休息的時間，有時也會忍不住拿來衡量自己。
idea.p3.en: In everyday life, there is so much we try to do well: work, life and plans for the future. Sometimes, we even judge ourselves by how we spend our time off.

idea.p4.zh-TW: 所以，我想做一座小島，留給那些暫時不想追趕什麼的時候。
idea.p4.en: So I wanted to make an island for the moments when you don’t feel like chasing anything.

idea.p5.zh-TW: 你可以花一個下午整理小屋，也可以只是上來看看，什麼都沒完成就離開。隔一陣子再回來，依然能接著過自己的生活。
idea.p5.en: Spend an afternoon arranging your cottage, or drop in and leave without finishing a thing. Come back after a while and carry on at your own pace.

idea.p6.zh-TW: 不需要天天登入，不需要和誰比較，也不必完成所有任務。
idea.p6.en: You don’t need to log in every day, compare yourself with anyone or finish every quest.

idea.h1.zh-TW: 從「有一間自己的小屋」開始
idea.h1.en: It starts with a cottage of your own

idea.p7.zh-TW: 我喜歡那些很小、卻讓人覺得生活是自己的細節。
idea.p7.en: I love the small details that make life feel like your own.

idea.p8.zh-TW: 一盞燈的顏色、窗邊的位置、散步時撿到的貝殼，還有今天想穿什麼出門。
idea.p8.en: The colour of a lamp, a spot by the window, a shell found on a walk, and what you feel like wearing today.

idea.p9.zh-TW: 在 Bear Atlas，你可以慢慢累積這些喜好，把一間小屋住成自己的樣子。門外則有另一個世界：咖啡館、花園、森林、市集，以及各自過著日子的動物居民。
idea.p9.en: In Bear Atlas, you can gather these little preferences and make a cottage your own. Outside is another world: a café, garden, forest, market and animal neighbours going about their days.

idea.p10.zh-TW: 想熱鬧一點，就出門走走；想安靜一點，就把時間留在家裡。
idea.p10.en: When you feel like company, take a walk outside. When you need quiet, keep a little time at home.

idea.h2.zh-TW: 日子過著過著，就懂了一點經濟學
idea.h2.en: Live a little, learn a little economics

idea.q1.zh-TW: 今天收成的胡蘿蔔，剛好能幫咖啡館做一份點心；下次豐收時，卻發現同樣一籃作物，居民的收購報價和上週不一樣。
idea.q1.en: Today’s carrots might help the café make a snack. At the next plentiful harvest, you might notice that the same basket earns a different offer from last week.

idea.q2.zh-TW: 島上準備蓋新房子，木材開始變得搶手；咖啡節快到了，居民也忙著多準備一些食材。
idea.q2.en: When the island prepares to build new homes, wood becomes more sought after. As the coffee festival approaches, residents start preparing extra ingredients.

idea.p11.zh-TW: 你可能會好奇：「為什麼會這樣？」
idea.p11.en: You might find yourself asking, “Why does that happen?”

idea.p12.zh-TW: 於是，從種菜、逛市場、幫居民完成委託的日常裡，慢慢看懂供給、需求與價格如何彼此影響。
idea.p12.en: Through growing crops, browsing the market and helping neighbours with orders, you begin to see how supply, demand and prices influence one another.

idea.p13.zh-TW: 我希望你在熊熊度假村過著喜歡的生活，某天回頭才發現：原來，自己已經懂了一點經濟學。
idea.p13.en: I hope you enjoy life in Bear Atlas and one day look back and realise: somewhere along the way, you’ve learned a little economics.

idea.p14.zh-TW: 在熊熊度假村生活，不知不覺就學會了一點經濟學。
idea.p14.en: Live in Bear Atlas, and pick up a little economics along the way.

idea.p15.zh-TW: 想多了解時，可以找楓教授聊聊；今天只想看海，也可以把問題留到下次。
idea.p15.en: When you want to know more, have a chat with Professor Maple. If today is just for watching the sea, your questions can wait.

idea.h3.en: Leave a little room for connection

idea.p16.zh-TW: 我希望這座島上的陪伴，可以很輕。
idea.p16.en: I hope companionship on this island can feel light.

idea.p17.zh-TW: 打個招呼、邀朋友看看新布置的小屋，或留下一次小小的拜訪，就足以讓原本獨自探索的日常，多一點溫度。
idea.p17.en: A hello, showing a friend your newly decorated cottage or a little visit can bring warmth to a day spent exploring on your own.

idea.p18.zh-TW: 你不必一直在線，也不必隨時有話可說。想靠近別人的時候，有一扇可以敲的門；想獨處的時候，也有自己的空間。
idea.p18.en: You don’t need to be online all the time or always have something to say. When you feel like company, there is a door to knock on. When you want solitude, there is space of your own.

idea.h4.en: Take your time, together with the island

idea.p19.zh-TW: Bear Atlas 是我一點一點搭起來的世界，也還有很多地方正在摸索。
idea.p19.en: Bear Atlas is a world I’m building little by little, with much still to discover.

idea.p20.zh-TW: 我想讓每一次更新，都替島上的生活多添一個細節：居民收到食材後的一句回應、一條更好走的小路，或一個讓你想停下來看看的角落。
idea.p20.en: With each update, I want to add a detail to island life: a neighbour’s response to receiving ingredients, a path that is easier to follow, or a corner that makes you want to pause.

idea.p21.zh-TW: 希望有一天，你回來的理由，會是惦記著自己種下的菜，想換個房間的擺設，或只是突然想看看這片海。
idea.p21.en: I hope that one day you return because you’re thinking of the crops you planted, feel like rearranging your room, or simply miss this stretch of sea.

idea.p22.zh-TW: 這座小島會慢慢長大，你也可以照自己的步調生活。
idea.p22.en: The island will grow slowly, and you can live at your own pace.

idea.p23.zh-TW: 願這座小島，成為你生活裡一個喜歡的地方。
idea.p23.en: May this little island become a place you love in your everyday life.

idea.end.zh-TW: 一座可以自在生活，也能帶著好奇探索的熊熊島嶼。
idea.end.en: An island where you can feel at home and follow your curiosity.

idea.back.en: Take a walk on the island

idea.cap1.zh-TW: 沿著熟悉的小路，找到今天想停留的角落。
idea.cap1.en: Follow a familiar path to the corner you’d like to stay in today.

idea.cap2.zh-TW: 一間亮著暖燈的小屋，留給自己的時間。
idea.cap2.en: A warmly lit cottage, and a little time for yourself.

idea.cap3.zh-TW: 一籃收成、一份點心，讓居民的日常連在一起。
idea.cap3.en: A basket of produce and a café snack connect everyday island life.

idea.cap4.zh-TW: 在小小的研究所，帶著好奇聊聊生活裡的價格。
idea.cap4.en: A little research house for curious conversations about everyday prices.

simple.homeHint.en: Decorate, rest and enjoy your collection

simple.joinHint.zh-TW: 先領島民證，擁有自己的家
simple.joinHint.en: Get a passport and a home of your own

simple.exploreHint.en: Follow the map at your own pace

simple.todayHint.en: A little story, yours to explore

simple.next.en: What would you like to do next?

simple.shop.en: Visit the shop to buy or craft

simple.afterExplore.zh-TW: 有了收成或探索物品，可以先看背包，再決定交付、交換或留在小屋展示。不是每件物品都能交訂單，接單前請先看條件。
simple.afterExplore.en: With a harvest or a found item, check your backpack and choose whether to deliver, exchange or display it. Orders accept specific items; review the terms first.

simple.afterOrder.zh-TW: 已交付的訂單會留下紀錄與居民回應。想用報酬買一份收藏，就去商店；也可以直接回家。未完成的訂單仍可留待下次。
simple.afterOrder.en: Completed orders leave a receipt and a resident’s reply. Visit the shop for a keepsake, or head home. Unfinished orders can wait for another visit.

simple.afterShop.zh-TW: 買到或製作好的收藏會進入背包。到展示架選擇位置，再回小屋看看；原有家具仍在小屋內布置。
simple.afterShop.en: Purchased or crafted keepsakes go into your backpack. Choose a shelf slot, then visit your cottage. Arrange your existing furniture inside the cottage.

simple.afterBag.zh-TW: 背包物品可以依各自支援的用途交換、贈送或展示。展示中的物品會保留，不會同時拿去交付。
simple.afterBag.en: Each item shows the actions it supports: exchange, gift or display. Displayed items stay reserved and cannot also be delivered.

simple.npc.zh-TW: 聊天之外，Hugo 與 Mika 也有食材委託。前往訂單頁查看各自用途、接單條件與已完成狀態；成交紀錄保留收貨回應。
simple.npc.en: Hugo and Mika also offer produce orders. The order page shows each resident’s purpose, terms and completion status; completed receipts keep their replies.

simple.harvest.zh-TW: 本週胡蘿蔔豐收，模擬供給增加，價格下降。
simple.harvest.en: A plentiful carrot harvest raises simulated supply and lowers the price this week.

simple.festival.zh-TW: 島上咖啡節帶動模擬需求，咖啡價格上升。
simple.festival.en: The island coffee festival raises simulated demand and the coffee price.

simple.building.zh-TW: 新建築施工增加模擬木材需求，木材價格上升。
simple.building.en: New construction raises simulated demand for wood and its price.

simple.stable.zh-TW: 本週沒有新事件；前期事件結束後，模擬市場回到一般供需。
simple.stable.en: There is no new event this week. As earlier events end, the simulated market returns to ordinary supply and demand.

simple.busy.en: Island activity: above the base period

simple.more.zh-TW: 了解更多：指數、價格與經濟週報
simple.more.en: Learn more: indices, prices and the bulletin

simple.optional.zh-TW: 想參與的話，可以去花園或看看居民委託；也可以只是看海。
simple.optional.en: If you feel like joining in, visit the garden or browse resident orders. Watching the sea is just as welcome.

simple.fallback.zh-TW: 今天也可以自在散步、照顧花園，或回小屋休息。
simple.fallback.en: Take a walk, tend your garden or rest at home today.

idea.future.zh-TW: 未來，我也想用熊熊銀行、利率與金融教育的故事，繼續探索生活與經濟的連結。這些仍是小島慢慢長大的願景，還沒有正式開放。
idea.future.en: In the future, I hope to explore the links between life and economics through stories about Bear Bank, interest rates and financial learning. These are ideas for the island’s gradual growth, not features that are open today.

experience.offline.zh-TW: 目前沒有網路。重新連線後再保存；先前已保存的進度會保留。
experience.offline.en: You are offline. Reconnect before saving. Previously saved progress is kept.

pocket.bagHint.zh-TW: 先看手上有什麼，再選用途：交付、展示或送朋友。
pocket.bagHint.en: See what you have, then choose a use: deliver, display or give to a friend.

pocket.shopHint.zh-TW: 看清價格、材料與已持有數量；買好後可直接回背包找到物品。
pocket.shopHint.en: Check prices, materials and what you own. Return straight to the item in your backpack after buying.

pocket.tasksHint.zh-TW: 先處理可領取的回饋，再看探索任務、居民故事與作物訂單。
pocket.tasksHint.en: Collect ready rewards, then explore adventure tasks, resident stories and crop orders.

pocket.checkItem.en: Find the item in your backpack

pocket.receiptNote.zh-TW: 物品已保存，接著可以查看或整理展示。
pocket.receiptNote.en: Your item is saved. You can now find it or arrange your display.

pocket.ordersHint.zh-TW: 這裡只顯示你已接受的訂單；交付前仍會再次確認可用物品。
pocket.ordersHint.en: These are orders you have accepted. Available items are checked again before delivery.

pocket.ordersUnavailable.zh-TW: 目前無法讀取訂單，背包與原本的任務仍可使用。
pocket.ordersUnavailable.en: Orders cannot be read right now. Your backpack and existing tasks are still available.

pocket.noOrders.zh-TW: 還沒有進行中的作物訂單。可以先看看居民需要什麼，再決定要不要接。
pocket.noOrders.en: No active crop orders. See what residents need before deciding to accept.

pocket.overview.en: What would you like to do?

pocket.storyHint.zh-TW: 想解鎖原有家具，可以回到居民的小故事。
pocket.storyHint.en: Visit resident stories to unlock the original furniture.

pocket.noMatches.zh-TW: 這件物品目前沒有進行中的作物訂單。
pocket.noMatches.en: There is no active crop order for this item.

pocket.orderUse.zh-TW: 有居民正需要這件物品

pocket.emptyGo.zh-TW: 先去找第一件喜歡的物品

pocket.emptyCategory.zh-TW: 這個分類還沒有物品，可以切回全部看看。
pocket.emptyCategory.en: No items in this group yet. Switch to All to see your other items.
